name: Rajnish Retail Limited
summary: Operating within India, Rajnish Retail Limited is a retail business firm. The company oversees brands spanning three primary sectors: a general retail segment, an FMCG division focused on Ayurvedic products, urban family salons, and a micro-investor segment. Its diverse product offerings encompass pharmaceuticals, consumer durables, and Ayurvedic personal care items. Incorporated in 1994, the company, headquartered in Mumbai, India, was previously known as Sheetal Diamonds Limited before rebranding to Rajnish Retail Limited in February 2024.
